adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed via `guests.filter(...)` only excluding emails already in `booking.attendees` and blacklisted emails, but it does not deduplicate duplicates within the incoming `guests` array itself. As a result, duplicate entries in `input.guests` can survive into `guestsFullDetails` and be inserted via `attendees.createMany` (no uniqueness guard is shown in this diff). Additionally, there is no explicit exclusion of the organizer's email (`organizer.email` / `booking.userPrimaryEmail`) unless they already exist in `booking.attendees`, so the organizer could be added as a new attendee/guest.
